$comment: Gate registry — ARCHITECTURE.md §7. Every executable gate (class A and B) is registered from day one and changes activation state as the milestone advances; it never appears or disappears. Class-C evidence (peer review, sign-off) is deliberately absent: it lives in the phase-exit checklist, not in a runner.

gates.description: dependency-cruiser: the eight layering rules of §3, plus the render kind inventory
Vitest suite, including the pegkit conformance suite
Packed-artifact assertions over every published subpath, plus publint and attw
Unknown kind and malformed known kind raise RenderError; valid structural objects render
Deferred-construct text fallback, diagnostics, dedup, and original-input offsets
Parse tree, normalized model and every landed renderer match the Ruby-generated expectations
Generated payloads validate against their schema and manifest hashes
Inputs the gem rejects are rejected here
Behavioural probe matrix for context-dependent symbols
Deep nesting, unmatched fences and long token runs fail cleanly in bounded time
Regenerate corpus and data from a clean gem checkout; diff must be empty
Seeded bounded input generator compared live against the gem
